summary: Foundation phase (sub-muyog1cw-01f37297) meets all five phase criteria, verified by checks the reviewer ran after the submission. The pinned check-script hashes match the plan values. scaffold-check and dataset-precheck pass. The current eval files equal the t02 freeze evidence and the HEAD commit, and no rules file exists in the tree or in git history. The helper self-test and npm test pass (21/21). A DES-1 mutation of spawn-server is caught by two self-test cases. Dataset labels follow E6 and the system-prompt urgency definitions. Every attack row declares a target, canary or url, and each canary or url appears in its ticket. The held-out families are absent from dataset.json, with 0 shared 5-grams. All personal data is synthetic. Four non-blocking findings are recorded for later phases.

criteria.description: Pinned instruments: sha256 of .eccode/artifacts/plan/checks/*.js equals the plan values (dataset-precheck c59b7acd..., readme-check a9a0128f..., scaffold-check e1fde7f9...), checked before relying on any check output

scaffold-check exits 0: package.json is exactly the spec §Deployment object (scripts start/test/eval/eval:tune, engines.node >=22, no dependencies, devDependencies or type); .env.example matches §Deployment line for line (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY empty, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL not defined, TRIAGE_* commented); .gitignore has .env and node_modules/. The reviewer also read all three files and compared them with spec §Deployment directly

dataset-precheck exits 0 (D5 format, all 13 datasetMinimums, the six in-family families, held-out families only in holdout.json, 23 >= 15 attack rows with a target). thresholds.json deep-equals the D5 block. Synthetic-data scan: all emails and urls use example domains, phones use 555, the one Luhn-valid number is a test card. Each canary and url appears in its ticket. Held-out families and 5-grams are absent from dataset.json. The reviewer also read every row: labels are plausible under E6

E5 freeze: three `eccode evidence file` records exist (dataset b024a838..., holdout e7cbbfd2..., thresholds ee4703c1...). The current files match them, and so does the HEAD commit aee61eb. Neither src/triage/injection.js nor src/triage/fallback-provider.js exists in the tree or in any git history
node --test test/helpers/helpers.test.js exits 0 on loopback only (21/21), and npm test exits 0 with the spec glob

Helpers conform to spec §Testing Strategy and DES-1. buildChildEnv is exactly {PATH, ...testEnv, PORT:'0'}, spawns process.execPath and copies nothing else from process.env; an independent mutation that spreads process.env fails 2 self-test cases. http-client uses node:http with agent:false; a host header in any case overrides Host; setHost:false sends no Host; Origin is passed through. fake-fetch implements respond, messageOk (thinkingFirst, usage), never (stays pending after abort), throws and capture. fake-anthropic binds loopback only, counts requests on arrival and serves 307/308 redirects; target B counts 0 requests under redirect:'error', with a live-counter control

findings.title: fake-fetch responses do not record whether the body was read
findings.detail: The pipeline-phase criterion and the unit/anthropic-provider row in spec §Testing Strategy require that "a stub answering 307 gives model_error/redirect_refused without reading the body". makeResponse() in test/helpers/fake-fetch.js returns text()/json() closures that track no reads, so respond(307, ...) cannot prove the body was left unread. t09 would have to hand-roll its own stub.
findings.recommendation: Resolved when makeResponse exposes a read counter, for example `res.bodyReads` incremented by text() and json(), and helpers.test.js covers it. Alternatively, t09's handoff shows a local stub that asserts text() was never called.

findings.title: Tune-mode flag FPR has 8 instructionLike rows, so one false positive fails it
findings.detail: dataset.json has 8 instructionLike benign rows; the union has 12. In tune mode (E3), injection_flag_fpr <= 0.10 tolerates 0/8, because 1/8 = 0.125. Full mode tolerates 1/12 = 0.083. In-family flag_recall >= 0.90 over 18 rows tolerates at most 1 miss. These numbers are consistent with the spec, but t11 should expect the tune check to be stricter than the full one.
findings.recommendation: No change to the frozen files. delivery-lead should pass this note to t11 (rules author) as tuning context, without holdout content.

findings.title: Redirect self-test control relies on localhost reaching 127.0.0.1
findings.detail: The 307/308 tests use Location http://localhost:<B>, matching AC4(o). B binds 127.0.0.1 only. The follow-mode control (B counts 1) passes here, but on a host where localhost resolves only to ::1 the control fails, while the redirect:'error' assertion would still hold.
findings.recommendation: Optional: t15 can reuse the same pattern. If CI shows a flake, bind B with host 'localhost' or use 127.0.0.1 in the control request.

findings.title: Labels come from a single labeller, and some rows are borderline by design
findings.detail: I read every row and found the labels plausible under E6 and the system-prompt urgency definitions. Rows such as b-052 and h-024 (phishing reports, labelled other/high) and b-029 (lost 2FA but still signed in on one device, labelled account/medium) are defensible but contestable. The t02 handoff already discloses this. Their effect on the accuracy metrics is small.
findings.recommendation: No change, because the files are frozen. The verification report should state that the labels have a single author (E7 honesty).
